tracks.title: ZTE Frontend Engineering
tracks.description: A project-centered frontend path covering browser foundations, accessible interfaces, typed application architecture, quality, performance, and career evidence.

phases.title: Web Platform and Tooling
phases.description: Understand the browser platform, command line, source control, package management, and developer workflow.

topics.title: Semantic HTML and document structure
objectives: Build valid documents with landmarks and headings
Choose native elements based on meaning
practice: Rebuild a content page using landmarks
Audit heading order and labels
evidence: Accessible semantic page with passing HTML validation

topics.title: Forms, validation, and browser behavior
objectives: Use native input types and constraints
Explain submission, focus, and browser validation
practice: Build a multi-field form with inline errors
Test keyboard-only submission
evidence: Form supports keyboard, labels, errors, and success state

topics.title: CSS layout, cascade, and responsive foundations
objectives: Explain cascade and box model
Compose responsive layouts with flexbox and grid
practice: Implement a responsive article and card grid
Debug specificity and overflow issues
evidence: Layout verified at narrow and wide viewport sizes

topics.title: Git branches, commits, and pull requests
objectives: Create reviewable commits
Resolve a simple merge conflict
practice: Use a feature branch and open a review checklist
Recover a mistaken local commit safely
evidence: Repository history has small descriptive commits and documented setup

topics.title: Browser devtools and debugging
objectives: Inspect DOM, styles, network, storage, and console
Trace a UI defect to its source
practice: Diagnose a broken layout and failed request
Record a reproducible defect report
evidence: Issue report includes steps, root cause, and fix

projects.title: Accessible responsive documentation site
projects.problem: Create a maintainable documentation site for a small open-source tool.
deliverables: README with setup and design decisions

phases.title: JavaScript for Interfaces
phases.description: Build a reliable mental model of JavaScript, browser events, asynchronous work, and testable UI behavior.

topics.title: Values, types, functions, and scope
objectives: Use primitives and objects deliberately
Explain lexical scope and closures
practice: Implement data transformations without mutation
Trace closure behavior in event handlers
evidence: Tested utility module with clear input/output contracts

topics.title: Arrays, objects, and data modeling
objectives: Choose arrays, maps, and objects for common problems
Normalize nested API-shaped data
practice: Build a searchable, sortable data selector
Write transformations with edge cases
evidence: Unit tests cover empty, duplicate, and invalid data

topics.title: DOM, events, and forms
objectives: Use event propagation and delegation
Keep DOM updates safe and predictable
practice: Build a filterable list without a framework
Implement form validation and focus management
evidence: Interaction works by keyboard and pointer

topics.title: Promises, async functions, and event loop
objectives: Explain task/microtask ordering at a useful level
Handle async errors and cancellation
practice: Build concurrent requests with loading and retry states
Prevent stale search results from replacing newer ones
evidence: Async UI handles success, error, empty, and cancellation

topics.title: HTTP, APIs, and browser storage
objectives: Inspect HTTP methods, status codes, and JSON contracts
Select storage based on lifetime and sensitivity
practice: Consume a paginated API
Document cache and persistence choices
evidence: API client validates response and reports recoverable errors

projects.title: Interactive browser utilities
projects.problem: Build a small suite of useful browser tools from local state and remote data.

phases.title: Component Applications with React
phases.description: Design reusable components, predictable state, forms, routing, and data loading for maintainable user interfaces.

topics.title: Component boundaries, props, and composition
objectives: Separate presentation from orchestration
Use composition instead of deeply coupled components
practice: Refactor a long page into reusable sections
Build a controlled dialog component
evidence: Component API is documented and covered by interaction tests

topics.title: State, reducers, and derived values
objectives: Keep state minimal and derive computed values
Choose local state, reducer, or shared state intentionally
practice: Model a multi-step editor with reducer transitions
Remove duplicated derived state
evidence: State transitions have unit tests and no synchronization effects

topics.title: Forms, validation, and accessible interactions
objectives: Connect labels, validation, errors, and status announcements
Manage focus for dialogs and navigation
practice: Build a validated settings form
Test dialog focus entry, containment, and return
evidence: Automated accessibility checks plus keyboard walkthrough

topics.title: Routing, layouts, and navigation states
objectives: Organize route layouts and loading boundaries
Preserve navigation semantics and useful URLs
practice: Add nested routes and a not-found state
Implement active navigation and query-driven filters
evidence: Routes work on direct load, refresh, and browser history

topics.title: Data fetching, caching, and optimistic updates
objectives: Model loading, error, stale, and empty states
Use optimistic updates with rollback
practice: Add a mutation with retry and conflict handling
Prevent stale cache keys across accounts
evidence: Integration tests cover cache invalidation and rollback

projects.title: Team issue tracker
projects.problem: Help a small team triage work and understand project status.
requirements: Issue list, detail, filtering, and status transitions

phases.title: TypeScript and Frontend Architecture
phases.description: Use types to make UI contracts safer and structure applications for change and collaboration.

topics.title: Unions, narrowing, and runtime boundaries
objectives: Model mutually exclusive UI states with discriminated unions
Validate untrusted values at runtime
practice: Model request states without impossible combinations
Parse API JSON with runtime validation
evidence: No unchecked external data crosses into domain state

topics.title: Generics and reusable component contracts
objectives: Write focused generics for data-driven components
Avoid over-generalized abstractions
practice: Build typed table and select primitives
Compare generic API complexity against duplication
evidence: Examples compile with valid and invalid usage cases

topics.title: Feature boundaries and dependency direction
objectives: Group code around product features
Keep UI, domain rules, and data access boundaries clear
practice: Refactor one feature into a domain module
Draw and review dependency graph
evidence: Feature can be changed without unrelated route edits

topics.title: Design systems and component governance
objectives: Define tokens and accessible component variants
Balance consistency with feature-specific needs
practice: Create button, field, dialog, and feedback patterns
Document contribution and visual review process
evidence: Shared components have usage guidance and tests

projects.title: Typed component library
projects.problem: Create a small reusable UI system for two related frontend surfaces.
requirements: Visual regression or documented manual checks

phases.title: Frontend Quality, Performance, and Delivery
phases.description: Ship robust interfaces with testing, security awareness, performance budgets, and production observability.

topics.title: Unit, integration, and browser tests
objectives: Choose test boundaries based on behavior risk
Write stable tests that assert user-visible outcomes
practice: Test a form submission and async failure
Add browser coverage for critical navigation
evidence: Critical flows have reliable CI tests with useful failure output

topics.title: Accessibility and inclusive interaction audit
objectives: Evaluate keyboard, semantics, contrast, motion, and screen-reader announcements
Prioritize barriers by user impact
practice: Run keyboard and zoom audit
Fix focus, labeling, and contrast defects
evidence: Recorded accessibility audit with resolved high-impact findings

topics.title: Web performance and rendering strategy
objectives: Measure Core Web Vitals and identify bottlenecks
Choose client/server rendering and caching based on data needs
practice: Profile a route and reduce its largest cost
Compare bundle and image-loading strategies
evidence: Before/after measurements and justified rendering decisions

topics.title: Frontend security and privacy
objectives: Prevent injection and unsafe URL handling
Avoid exposing secrets or sensitive data in client bundles and telemetry
practice: Review a form and rich-content path for XSS risks
Inspect production bundle and network payloads
evidence: Threat checklist and no sensitive values in client output

topics.title: Deployment, monitoring, and incident response
objectives: Use environment configuration and staged releases
Interpret client errors and recover safely
practice: Deploy preview and production release
Simulate a failed release and rollback
evidence: Runbook, health signals, and verified rollback

projects.title: Production-grade frontend product
projects.problem: Deliver a polished product interface for a real workflow with measurable user outcomes.
requirements: Typed API boundary and robust error states

tracks.title: ZTE Backend Engineering with Java
tracks.description: A production-oriented Java backend path covering language depth, APIs, data modeling, distributed systems, cloud operations, and system design.

phases.title: Java and Engineering Foundations
phases.description: Build fluency in Java, tooling, Git, testing, and core programming models.

topics.title: Types, control flow, methods, and object design
objectives: Use Java types and methods to express domain rules
Explain object identity, equality, and immutability
practice: Model a small order domain
Test edge cases and invalid states
evidence: Well-tested domain package with clear invariants

topics.title: Collections, generics, and complexity
objectives: Choose collection types based on behavior and complexity
Use generics without unsafe casts
practice: Implement indexes and deduplication
Compare lookup costs on representative data
evidence: Documented choices with tests and complexity notes

topics.title: Exceptions, resource safety, and debugging
objectives: Use exceptions for failure paths and preserve context
Manage resources with structured cleanup
practice: Build a resilient file importer
Trace failures using debugger and logs
evidence: Importer handles malformed data and closes resources

topics.title: JVM, build tools, and dependency management
objectives: Explain compilation, bytecode, JVM, and classpath basics
Use Maven or Gradle reproducibly
practice: Create a multi-package build
Inspect dependency tree and lock versions
evidence: Clean build works from documented setup

topics.title: JUnit, test design, and Git workflow
objectives: Test behavior at unit and integration boundaries
Keep changes reviewable and recoverable
practice: Add parameterized tests
Review a change using a branch and pull request
evidence: CI runs tests and style checks on each change

projects.title: Reliable command-line data processor
projects.problem: Import, validate, transform, and export a realistic dataset with clear failure reporting.

phases.title: SQL, Relational Modeling, and Persistence
phases.description: Design relational data, query effectively, and make persistence correct under concurrency and change.

topics.title: Normalization, keys, and constraints
objectives: Design entities and constraints from business invariants
Explain normalization tradeoffs
practice: Model users, orders, and line items
Add uniqueness and referential constraints
evidence: Schema captures invariants and migration is repeatable

topics.title: SQL joins, aggregation, and query plans
objectives: Write joins and aggregates correctly
Read an execution plan and identify missing indexes
practice: Answer reporting questions with SQL
Tune a slow query using representative data
evidence: Query results match fixtures and plan improvements are measured

topics.title: Transactions, isolation, and locking
objectives: Explain atomicity and isolation anomalies
Choose transaction boundaries and retry behavior
practice: Reproduce a lost update
Implement safe idempotent command handling
evidence: Concurrency test demonstrates invariant preservation

topics.title: JDBC, connection pools, and transaction boundaries
objectives: Use parameterized queries and connection pooling
Keep transactions short and explicit
practice: Implement repository operations with rollback
Observe pool saturation behavior
evidence: Integration tests prove commit/rollback and no leaked connections

topics.title: ORM mapping and migration discipline
objectives: Understand entity lifecycle and N+1 query risks
Evolve schema without losing production data
practice: Profile generated SQL
Write expand/backfill/contract migration
evidence: Migration tested against populated fixture and rollback plan

projects.title: Transactional inventory and ordering service
projects.problem: Keep inventory correct while customers place concurrent orders.

phases.title: Spring Boot Services and API Design
phases.description: Build maintainable service APIs with validation, security boundaries, testing, and operational behavior.

topics.title: Dependency injection and application boundaries
objectives: Use constructor injection and explicit configuration
Separate transport, application, and domain responsibilities
practice: Refactor a controller-heavy service
Test domain logic without starting the framework
evidence: Layer boundaries are visible and testable

topics.title: REST contracts, validation, and error semantics
objectives: Design stable resource and command endpoints
Return consistent validation and failure responses
practice: Specify API with OpenAPI
Implement pagination and error mapping
evidence: Contract tests validate success, errors, and compatibility

topics.title: Authentication and authorization
objectives: Distinguish identity from permission
Enforce object-level access at the server boundary
practice: Implement role and ownership checks
Test access-control matrix including forged IDs
evidence: Negative authorization tests block cross-account access

topics.title: Spring integration tests and test containers
objectives: Test persistence and web behavior against realistic dependencies
Keep tests deterministic
practice: Test migrations with an ephemeral database
Exercise API behavior with Testcontainers
evidence: CI runs integration suite using pinned images

topics.title: Timeouts, retries, and failure handling
objectives: Use timeouts and bounded retries safely
Avoid retrying non-idempotent operations blindly
practice: Simulate a slow downstream
Implement circuit-breaking or bulkhead policy where justified
evidence: Failure tests prove bounded resource use and clear errors

projects.title: Multi-tenant Spring service
projects.problem: Provide a secure service API for organizations managing shared work items.
requirements: Validated REST API and OpenAPI contract

phases.title: Distributed Systems, Messaging, and Caching
phases.description: Reason about service boundaries, asynchronous workflows, consistency, and failure in distributed systems.

topics.title: Service boundaries and domain ownership
objectives: Choose service boundaries based on change and data ownership
Identify when a modular monolith is preferable
practice: Split a bounded context on paper
Compare deployment and operational cost
evidence: Architecture decision record with alternatives and tradeoffs

topics.title: Messaging, delivery semantics, and outbox
objectives: Explain at-least-once delivery and idempotent consumers
Keep database changes and emitted events consistent
practice: Implement transactional outbox and replay-safe consumer
Test duplicate and delayed messages
evidence: Consumer handles duplicates; event loss window is documented

topics.title: Caching and consistency
objectives: Choose cache keys, TTL, and invalidation strategy
Reason about stale reads and cache stampede
practice: Add bounded cache to a read-heavy endpoint
Test invalidation and concurrent misses
evidence: Load test shows measured improvement without stale-data violation

topics.title: Observability and service-level objectives
objectives: Use structured logs, metrics, and traces together
Define useful SLOs and alert thresholds
practice: Instrument a request across service and database
Create an error-budget alert
evidence: Dashboard and alert resolve a simulated incident

topics.title: Capacity, backpressure, and graceful degradation
objectives: Recognize queue and pool saturation
Protect critical paths under load
practice: Load test and observe queue growth
Add bounded concurrency and graceful fallback
evidence: Load report identifies safe operating range

projects.title: Event-driven order processing platform
projects.problem: Process orders across payment, inventory, and fulfillment despite retries and partial failure.

phases.title: Cloud Delivery, System Design, and Career Evidence
phases.description: Prepare backend systems for production scale and demonstrate engineering judgment in interviews and portfolio work.

topics.title: Containers, orchestration, and deployment topology
objectives: Package services reproducibly
Choose deployment topology based on reliability and cost
practice: Containerize the service
Deploy to a managed runtime with health probes
evidence: Reproducible deployment and rollback procedure

topics.title: Security, secrets, and supply chain
objectives: Manage secrets outside source and client payloads
Reduce dependency and container attack surface
practice: Threat review service-to-database path
Generate and review dependency inventory
evidence: Security checklist and vulnerability response process

topics.title: Capacity estimation and data partitioning
objectives: Estimate throughput, storage, and hot-key risk
Choose indexes, partitions, and retention policies
practice: Estimate a notification service at target volume
Model growth and operational cost
evidence: Design includes assumptions, calculations, and bottleneck plan

topics.title: Backend interview communication
objectives: Clarify requirements before proposing architecture
Explain tradeoffs and failure handling under time pressure
practice: Run a timed API and system-design mock
Review answer against a structured rubric
evidence: Recorded mock review with concrete follow-up actions

projects.title: Production-ready backend capstone
projects.problem: Deliver a service that solves a real workflow and can be operated by another engineer.
requirements: Secure API and clear data model

tracks.title: ZTE Full-Stack Product Engineering
tracks.description: An end-to-end path for building, securing, testing, deploying, and operating complete web products across browser, API, data, and delivery layers.

phases.title: Web and Programming Foundations
phases.description: Build the browser, JavaScript, command-line, and source-control foundations required to work across the stack.

topics.title: Semantic HTML, CSS layout, and accessibility
objectives: Structure pages with semantic landmarks and accessible controls
Create responsive layouts with modern CSS
practice: Build an accessible responsive product landing page
Test keyboard navigation and viewport changes
evidence: Deployed page with accessibility and responsive checks

topics.title: JavaScript language and browser APIs
objectives: Use functions, objects, collections, and modules confidently
Handle events and asynchronous browser work
practice: Build a data-driven interactive page
Consume an API with loading and error states
evidence: Tested interaction with robust async states

topics.title: Git, package tooling, and local debugging
objectives: Create reviewable changes with Git
Use package scripts and browser/server debugging tools
practice: Set up a repeatable project with lint and test commands
Investigate a failing request and layout defect
evidence: New engineer can clone, run, test, and understand the project

topics.title: Programming problem solving and data structures
objectives: Analyze common time/space tradeoffs
Select arrays, maps, sets, stacks, and queues for basic tasks
practice: Solve representative search and transformation tasks
Explain complexity and test boundaries
evidence: Solutions include tests and plain-language complexity notes

projects.title: Personal project workspace
projects.problem: Organize a user's project ideas and show useful progress at a glance.

phases.title: Typed Frontend Application Development
phases.description: Build a maintainable typed frontend with reusable components, state boundaries, routes, and resilient API communication.

topics.title: Components, composition, and state modeling
objectives: Design components around behavior and clear public props
Represent UI states without duplicated or impossible state
practice: Refactor a feature into composable components
Model a multi-step form with explicit transitions
evidence: Component and state logic has behavior-level tests

topics.title: TypeScript at application boundaries
objectives: Use unions and narrowing for safe UI state
Validate untrusted API values at runtime
practice: Type an API client and error model
Parse malformed success/error payloads
evidence: External JSON is validated before entering typed domain code

topics.title: Routing, forms, and accessible interactions
objectives: Build routes with direct-load and history behavior
Support labels, keyboard, focus, and validation
practice: Add nested routes and a validated form
Audit dialogs and menus with keyboard only
evidence: Critical UI journeys pass keyboard and interaction checks

topics.title: Client data states and caching
objectives: Model loading, empty, stale, and error states
Use cache invalidation and optimistic updates safely
practice: Implement editable list with retry and rollback
Test rapid requests and stale responses
evidence: Integration tests verify state and cache behavior

projects.title: Collaborative work board frontend
projects.problem: Give a small team an understandable interface for shared work and updates.
requirements: Responsive routes for boards and work items

phases.title: APIs, Databases, and Authentication
phases.description: Build server-side application behavior with clear contracts, durable relational state, and ownership-aware authorization.

topics.title: HTTP contracts and REST API design
objectives: Choose resource and command boundaries
Use status codes, validation, pagination, and stable errors
practice: Specify API with OpenAPI
Implement filtered list and idempotent creation
evidence: Contract tests cover valid, invalid, and not-found cases

topics.title: Server architecture and domain rules
objectives: Separate transport, application, and domain responsibilities
Keep business invariants testable without framework startup
practice: Move rules out of route handlers
Test domain behavior with representative fixtures
evidence: Architecture note shows dependency direction and invariant tests

topics.title: Relational modeling, SQL, and migrations
objectives: Model keys, constraints, and relations from domain rules
Evolve schemas safely with existing data
practice: Design a normalized project/work-item schema
Write and test expand/backfill/contract migrations
evidence: Migration passes against populated fixtures with rollback plan

topics.title: Authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation
objectives: Distinguish authentication from permission
Enforce ownership and role checks at every data boundary
practice: Test forged IDs and cross-account access attempts
Review query, API, and database policy behavior
evidence: Two-account negative tests prove record isolation

projects.title: Secure multi-user project API
projects.problem: Expose project and work-item workflows for separate user accounts without leaking data.

phases.title: Production Full-Stack Architecture

topics.title: End-to-end testing and deployment pipelines
objectives: Test the user journey across browser and server
Automate repeatable builds and staged deployments
practice: Run browser tests against preview deployment
Add migration and smoke gates to CI
evidence: Release pipeline blocks broken flows and supports rollback

topics.title: Caching, queues, and background processing
objectives: Choose synchronous versus asynchronous work deliberately
Make background handlers retry-safe and observable
practice: Move slow notification work to a queue
Test duplicate delivery and dead-letter recovery
evidence: Failure exercise proves safe retry and recovery

topics.title: System performance across browser, API, and database
objectives: Profile user-perceived latency end-to-end
Identify query, payload, rendering, and network bottlenecks
practice: Measure a critical flow before and after optimization
Set and validate performance budgets
evidence: Reproducible benchmark and measured improvement

topics.title: Logging, metrics, tracing, and incident response
objectives: Correlate requests without logging secrets or personal data
Use service objectives to prioritize incident response
practice: Trace a request across layers
Simulate a dependency failure and rollback
evidence: Dashboard/runbook supports diagnosis and recovery

projects.title: Production multi-user SaaS application
projects.problem: Deliver a complete product with account isolation and a meaningful multi-step user workflow.
requirements: Frontend and API with shared contracts

phases.title: Career Readiness and Engineering Judgment
phases.description: Demonstrate delivery ownership, explain tradeoffs, and prepare a coherent evidence-backed portfolio and interview story.

topics.title: Requirements, scale estimates, and architecture choices
objectives: Clarify functional and nonfunctional requirements
Estimate load and choose architecture proportional to need
practice: Design a team collaboration product under changing scale assumptions
Compare modular monolith and service decomposition
evidence: Design record states constraints, alternatives, and failure modes

topics.title: Security review and production operations
objectives: Identify trust boundaries, sensitive data, and abuse paths
Plan backup, restore, retention, and account deletion
practice: Run a lightweight threat review
Perform a backup restore and account data export
evidence: Security and recovery report with verified restore steps

topics.title: Portfolio narrative and technical evidence
objectives: Connect project outcomes to concrete engineering decisions
Present measurable evidence without overstating impact
practice: Write a case study with tradeoffs and results
Prepare a concise architecture walkthrough
evidence: Reviewed portfolio story linked to deployed project and repository

topics.title: Full-stack interview practice
objectives: Communicate assumptions and tradeoffs clearly
Debug and improve an end-to-end feature under time constraints
practice: Complete timed coding and design mocks
Review gaps and schedule targeted practice
evidence: Interview log with feedback themes and follow-up actions

projects.title: Capstone launch and technical case study

Production deployment and monitored critical path
